plan.title: Live RFQ Counter Offer Stays Pending

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two submitted bids on the buyer side.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are available.
Ensure eRFX project flows are enabled for the tenant.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the live bid can be countered.
Send the buyer’s counter offer against Vendor A’s normal bid.
Confirm the buyer grid marks Vendor A’s counter offer as initiated.
Verify the counter offer remains pending and can still be revoked.
Open Vendor A’s separate supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ pricing round for Vendor A.

args.because: You have a counter offer pending on this bid

steps.note: Try to revise the bid and require Procol to refuse it while the counter offer is pending.
Return to the buyer session without accepting or changing the counter offer.
Reopen the buyer comparison grid to verify the original bid remains unchanged.
Confirm Vendor A’s comparison rate is still the original bid value of 100.
